text: くさ　タイプは　そだてる　のが　らくな　ところが　いいわ

structure.jp: そだてる　のが　らくな

structure.en: that side of them is nice

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. そだてる　のが = 'raising them (is ...)'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to finish a sentence. いいわ = 'is nice'.
